name: aixy
description: Connect Claude Code to your Aixy tools with a personal MCP token.

mcp_url.title: Aixy MCP endpoint
mcp_url.description: Copy Your MCP endpoint from Agent tools → Connect an agent in your Aixy dashboard. Use your deployment's trusted HTTPS endpoint.

mcp_token.title: Personal Aixy MCP token
mcp_token.description: Create a personal MCP token in Agent tools → Connect an agent and paste only its value. Do not use a model API key or include the Bearer prefix.
